section.title: Introduction and Overview
section.p: From version 1.73 onward of SpriteExtend a new reason code has been added to OS_SpriteOp (and the variants which use this) to tile a sprite across the graphics window. This operation allows a single system call to be used to render a large number of images. It allows tiled area fills to be accelerated better than it would be for multiple sprite operations.

entry.register-use: Pointer to sprite name, or pointer to sprite dependant on R0
Pointer to scale factors, or 0 for 1:1 scaling
Pointer to pixel translation table, or 0 if none

use.p: This reason code is used to tile the sprite specified across the graphics window. The origin supplied in R3 and R4 will be used as the location of the bottom left corner of the sprites. The origin may be located within the graphics window, or outside it and will be bounded to the window.
